jurisdictionCoverage.note: Only the City of Austin was checked (2026-11-18). Unincorporated Travis County and the county's other cities were not researched.

permitsIssuedBy.limits: The portal says it serves City of Austin permitting; which addresses it covers was not quoted.

buildingDepartment.note: The portal's footer links Austin Development Services.

quirks: Open the “Property / Project Name / Types / Date Range” tab
Enter the address in parts: number, direction (N, S, E, W), street name and street type
Change the Start Date to 01-01-1980 or earlier. Without it, the search only covers the past year
No login needed. Results can take half a minute to appear

addressSearchTested.value: Anonymous search for 301 W 2nd St (Austin City Hall) from 1980 to 2026 listed 661 records of all types; limited to Building Permit before 2000 it listed 56, the oldest from 1980.

onlineRecordsFrom.value: 1980 or earlier (the oldest building permit at the address we searched)
onlineRecordsFrom.limits: The city does not state where online records begin; 1980 was the start of the range we searched, at one public address.

inspectionHistoryVisible.reason: One 1980 record was opened and showed no inspection list; a recent residential permit was not opened.

value: The search covers only the past 365 days unless you change the Start Date. Set it back to 1980 or earlier before deciding a permit is missing.
Results can take half a minute to appear.
Results mix every record type (water taps, events, right-of-way). Pick 'Building Permit', 'Electrical Permit', 'Plumbing Permit' or 'Mechanical Permit' under Permit/Case Type to narrow them.
A finished permit shows the status 'Final'. 'VOID' means it was cancelled, not completed.
